root_cause: IntrinsicHeight was an UnconstrainedBox alias, which removed the incoming width constraints.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/sizing_constraints.rs (IntrinsicHeight -> WidgetKind::ProxyLayout IntrinsicHeight); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/layout/behavior/core.rs (ProxyLayout arm: keeps width, tightens height to the child's measured natural height unless already tight)
harness: layout__box_constraints__limited_overflow_intrinsic: not rerun in this pass (see report)
limitations: Natural height is measured with a loose-height layout pass, not Flutter's getMaxIntrinsicHeight dry layout.
note: Under a tight incoming height the child fills it, as Flutter does.

root_cause: OverflowBox had no alignment; the child was always placed at the box origin.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/sizing_constraints.rs (OverflowBox alignment field, default Alignment::CENTER, builder method alignment()); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/layout/behavior/core.rs (Overflow arm uses aligned_child_offset); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/widget/geometry.rs (aligned_child_offset helper)
harness: layout__box_constraints__limited_overflow_intrinsic: not rerun in this pass (see report)
api_change: OverflowBox gains alignment(Alignment). Default is center, so overflowing children that were top-left now center. Migrate with .alignment(Alignment::TOP_LEFT).
limitations: Box size is still constrain(child size), not Flutter's fit=max biggest(). A loose OverflowBox smaller than its parent is sized to its child. Not in findings; residual.

root_cause: Same as text-011: the 12 px Inter baseline was the rounded ascent (12, so the row offset was 11) instead of Flutter's 11.625.
change: crates/incular-text/src/engine.rs snap_line_boxes (see text-011). No change in incular-layout.
harness: layout__baseline__cross_axis: match (was 0.625 px off); layout__baseline__without_baseline_child still matches; layout__ 35/37 (the remaining table and box_constraints divergences are unrelated).

root_cause: UnconstrainedBox had no alignment; the render kind always returned a zero child offset.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/sizing_constraints.rs (UnconstrainedBox alignment field, default center, builder method); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/layout/behavior/core.rs (Unconstrained arm aligns the child using its measured size)
harness: layout__unconstrained_box__constrained_axis: not rerun in this pass (see report)
api_change: UnconstrainedBox gains alignment(Alignment). Default center (Flutter). Overflowing children that sat top-left now center.
limitations: Smaller-child case confirmed by reading only; no Clip.hardEdge twin.
note: IntrinsicWidth keeps top-left through an explicit TOP_LEFT alignment.

root_cause: Table only had max-content columns and top-only cell placement; no column width or vertical alignment API.
change: crates/incular-layout/src/descriptors.rs (TableColumnWidth Fixed/Fraction/Intrinsic/Flex with Flex(1.0) default; TableCellVerticalAlignment Top/Middle/Bottom; Table fields and column_width lookup); crates/incular-layout/src/algorithms.rs (table_column_widths; layout_table vertical placement); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/layout/behavior/containers.rs (two passes: measure, then lay each cell at its tight column width); crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/table.rs (builder API); kind fields in tree.rs, tree/specs.rs, tree/rendering/lowering/layout.rs, tree/widget/structure.rs
harness: layout__table__default_flex_columns: not rerun in this pass (see report)
api_change: Table gains column_width(index, TableColumnWidth), default_column_width(...), default_vertical_alignment(...). The default column width changes from max-content to Flex(1.0), so a bounded Table now fills its width. Migrate with .default_column_width(TableColumnWidth::Intrinsic).
limitations: Not implemented: Fill, Baseline and IntrinsicHeight vertical alignments; column deficit shrinking when content exceeds the max width; Flutter's minIntrinsicWidth for flex columns. Table borders not checked. No per-cell alignment.
note: Cells are re-measured at their tight column width, as Flutter lays cells out.

root_cause: No public BoxConstraints.enforce; the only helper was a private intersection function in incular-layout.
change: crates/incular-config/src/constraints.rs (pub fn enforce(self, other) clamps each bound into other)
harness: layout__box_constraints__helper_values: enforce_min_w now has a value; not rerun in this pass
api_change: Adds Constraints::enforce(self, other: Constraints) -> Constraints. The private incular-layout enforce_constraints is unchanged.
limitations: Clamps, as Flutter does; not the private intersection helper.

root_cause: fractional_constraints used 0 as the minimum on an axis without a factor, instead of the parent's minimum.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/widget/geometry.rs (fractional_constraints keeps the parent minimum and maximum on axes without a factor)
harness: layout__fractionally_sized_box__null_factor_tight_parent: not rerun in this pass (see report)

root_cause: Expansible composed the body with a boolean; there was no retained animation.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/utilities.rs (Expansible builds Column(header, body or empty) inside AnimatedSize with duration (default 200 ms) and curve (default Curve::Ease), Clip::HardEdge; new duration() and curve() builders)
harness: misc__expansible_height_animation: not rerun in this pass (see report)
api_change: Expansible gains duration(Duration) and curve(Curve); defaults match Flutter.
limitations: A collapsed body is replaced by an empty box, so body state is not kept while collapsed (Flutter keeps it offstage). Only the height is animated, not a SizeTransition with a factor. No unit test added.

root_cause: RotatedBox was a paint-only transform; layout never swapped dimensions for odd quarter turns.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/transforms.rs (RotatedBox wraps Transform::rotation in WidgetKind::ProxyLayout QuarterTurns); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/layout/behavior/core.rs (odd turns lay out with flipped constraints, a swapped size, and a centered child)
harness: misc__rotated_box_layout_size: not rerun in this pass (see report)
limitations: Even turns keep the child size. Turn 3 uses the same path (rem_euclid).

root_cause: SafeArea adjusted its own geometry but did not publish the consumed insets to descendants, so nested SafeAreas padded twice.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/safe_area.rs (From<SafeArea> builds padding from context.safe_insets() and scopes the reduced insets for consumed sides via safe_insets_scope); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/context.rs (safe_insets_scope helper); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree.rs (re-export)
harness: misc__safe_area_nested_consumption: not rerun in this pass (see report)
limitations: When maintain_bottom_view_padding is set, the retained render arm is still used and descendants do not see reduced insets. Flutter also reduces viewPadding on consumed sides; view padding is not scoped here. The finding's fix direction said to keep view padding unchanged; Flutter's removePadding (widgets/media_query.dart:863-884) does reduce it, so the safe-insets part follows the source and the view-padding part is a residual.
note: Only the top edge was traced by the scenario.

root_cause: KeyedSubtree overwrote the child's own key with its outer key.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/utility.rs (a keyed child is wrapped in a transparent Builder that carries the outer key; unkeyed children keep the direct key path)
limitations: Adds one transparent element only when the child already has a key.

root_cause: Placeholder is implemented but not re-exported from incular-widgets or the facade.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/lib.rs (Placeholder in the layout re-export list); crates/incular/src/lib.rs (facade export)
api_change: Adds public export of Placeholder from incular-widgets and incular. Also re-exports TableColumnWidth and TableCellVerticalAlignment there.
